title: BROWN EYED WOMAN
lyrics_plain:
You look at me,
and baby all you see
Are my blue eyes.
I'm not a man,
baby all I am
is what I symbolize.
Brown eyed woman.
(Stay away baby.)
Brown eyed woman.
(Stay away baby.)
Brown eyed woman.
(Stay away baby.)
I could love you so, (no, no).
I could love you so, (no, no).
Brown eyed woman,
I could love you so,
(Mm, mm, mm.)
All of the years,
all the hate and the fears,
Have twisted your heart.
Now, you turn away,
you won't trust what I say,
And it's tearing me apart.
Brown eyed woman,
(Stay away, baby.)
Brown eyed woman,
(Stay away baby.)
Brown eyed woman,
(Stay away baby.)
I could love you so,
(Yes, yes.)
I could love you so,
(No, no.)
I'm holding out my hand to you.
Darling, tell me, tell me please
What more can I do.
Brown eyed woman.
(Stay away baby.)
Brown eyed woman.
(Stay away baby.)
I want you, I need you.
(Stay away baby.)
I'm holding out my hand.
(Stay away baby.)
I don't wanna' stay away,
No, no.
(Stay away baby.)
